name: Add more interactive commands to cli-watch
summary: Enhance cli-watch with additional interactive capabilities (e.g., auto-reload, better formatting) and document/implement TUI keystroke interactions (like 'q' for quit).

rawActions.name: Add a status line at the bottom of nf watch output showing available keys (e.g., q:quit)
rawActions.summary: Add a compact status line at the bottom of terminal showing available keys and current verbosity level. Implement handlers: q=quit, h=show help (list all commands with descriptions), +/-=increase/decrease verbosity (update display immediately)
rawActions.statusNote: Status line with keyboard handlers: h/help, space/refresh, +/-/arrows for verbosity

rawActions.name: Implement 'nf task get --json' to return the current task as JSON
rawActions.summary: Implement 'nf task get --json' to return the current task as JSON. Requirements: Output must be valid, unformatted JSON without ANSI escape codes, containing full (untruncated) actions and references. Implementation will involve branching logic in src/cli/cli-task.ts based on the --json flag.
